whatChanged: Engine returns one or two follow-up cards. Complete typed inputs still produce the existing numeric scenario; otherwise targeted cards lead to a qualitative forecast, without invented numeric defaults.
Video export, local server rendering endpoint, ffmpeg runtime requirement and its integration test are removed. Actual export remains a local 1080x1920 PNG.
Two-step skippable onboarding feeds You. Shared profile fields are birthday, lowercase sunSign, nullable ageBand, and optional birthTime, birthPlace, moonSign, risingSign.
Every new forecast has dueDate (YYYY-MM-DD). Free Why includes an astrological line and real answer-based reasoning; mock Plus exposes deeper explanation, inputs, assumptions and source leads.
Person readings take a first name, notify nobody, and apply stricter output screening to teen and unknown-age users. Under-13 onboarding blocks before cloud identity creation.

criticalFacts.fact: Reducing cards does not feed missing values into numeric calculations: the engine chooses the typed branch only when no more than two typed inputs remain; incomplete scenarios use qualitative generation.
criticalFacts.proofLevel: real code and real local engine
criticalFacts.observed: One-card money forecast returned a qualitative direction; one-card Spanish reading retained six months. Typed 100 + 2*4 scenario still returns 108 in executable tests.

criticalFacts.fact: The UI traverses the returned card length, and optional new forecast fields do not invalidate older history records.
criticalFacts.proofLevel: live app, including two explicit pre-change storage fixtures
criticalFacts.observed: Adult and teen real-model readings, reload/reopening, unchanged credit on failed generation, and successful retry passed. Two seeded legacy-storage fixtures (with and without an invalid birthday) preserved history, credits and unrelated facts; their old reveal/Why opened without dueDate.

criticalFacts.fact: Profile age and sign fields survive actual storage/reload, skipped age uses null, and under-13 onboarding does not retain the submitted birthday or complete onboarding.
criticalFacts.observed: Adult Gemini and teen Capricorn profiles; nullable skipped profile; persisted under-13 block; real local ephemeris returned Capricorn Moon and Virgo rising for the synthetic Copenhagen birth fixture.

cleared: One-repair-then-error provider behavior remains covered by the existing tests.
Unrelated typed memories remain excluded from general plans and forecasts; the Why basis excludes birthday/current-focus placeholders in favor of reading answers.
An actual PNG download has 1080x1920 dimensions and was visually inspected: only headline, brand and speculative label, no birth profile or private answers.
No production caller remains for the deleted animated export. Historical research/grade evidence and captures are retained.
risksAndLimits: Semantic model reliability and predictive accuracy are not proved by these structural checks or the small live sample. Teen output screening remains a fallible local-model classifier, not a public safety clearance.
Due date is optional on legacy history. Retention owns scheduling and must handle legacy records without it.
Plus entitlement is the existing local mock. Production server-side entitlement enforcement is not implemented here.
City search uses a no-key Open-Meteo/GeoNames non-commercial prototype endpoint. Production requires a licensed or self-hosted lookup. Birthday and birth time stay on device for chart calculation.
Birthday-only Sun sign uses conventional date boundaries; complete time/place are used for the Moon/rising ephemeris calculation.
Native share sheet, keyboard, voice, haptics and on-device ephemeris execution remain unverified because Xcode/device setup is unavailable. iOS bundle export passes.

The local Supabase mirror was not configured in these isolated browser profiles. Cloud identity non-creation for blocked onboarding is also supported by the explicit mirror gate in src/store.tsx; live RLS was not rerun.
